It's incredibly effective against metal or anything wet.|Inventory|BotW}} also known as {{Term/Store|Lightning Arrow|Lightning Arrows|CoH|plural}},{{Exp Game|CoH}}{{Cite|You got some {{Color CoH|Yellow|lightning arrows}}!|N/A|CoH}} are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Arrow |strength = |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Shock Arrow}} Shock Arrows are a type of [[Arrow]] which can be used with any [[Bow]]. While they most commonly appear in singles, they can also be found in bundles.{{Cite|{{Big|Shock Arrow x5}}
A bundle of five shock arrows.
Shock arrows break apart on impact, channeling electricity into nearby objects. Very effective against metals and moisture.|N/A|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Shock Arrow x10}}
A bundle of 10 shock arrows.
Shock arrows break apart on impact, channeling electricity into nearby objects. Very effective against metals and moisture.|N/A|BotW}} Shock Arrows immediately dissipate into a burst of electricity upon impact. If [[Link]] or an [[Enemy]] is shot by a Shock Arrow, they are electrocuted and stunned for a short period of time. Therefore, they're noted to be effective against wet opponents and metal. In addition, if Link is using any equipped items while shocked, they are dropped to the ground. They can be dropped by archer [[Enemies in Breath of the Wild|Enemies]] or found inside [[Treasure Chest]]s. The following locations sell Shock Arrows: * The [[Arrow Specialty Shop]] in [[Gerudo Town]] * The [[General Shoppe]] in [[Korok Forest]] * The [[Slippery Falcon (Tarrey Town Branch)]] * [[Shaillu]]'s arrow store in [[Kara Kara Bazaar]] * The fish market in [[Lurelin Village]] * [[Jini]] at the [[Mounted Archery Camp]] (only during rain) Shock Arrows deal an additional 20 damage to the attack power of the Bow being used. When shot at a body of water, they create a damaging area of effect around the Shock Arrow's point of impact. Shock Arrows also inflict extra damage when used in the [[Rain]].{{Cite|If you use a {{Color BotW|Blue|shock arrow}} when it's raining, it does extra damage.|Daz|BotW}} [[Bokoblin]]s, [[Moblin]]s, [[Lizalfos]], and [[Lynel]]s can sometimes be found using them. Shock Arrows can send surges of electricity through conductive objects, such as metal crates and metal [[Weapon]]s. [[Zora]] are known to be highly susceptible to damage from Shock Arrows.{{Cite|Unfortunately, as an aquatic race, we Zora are terribly vulnerable to electricity.|Sidon|BotW}} [[Seggin]], however, is noted to be more resistant to them than the average Zora, and is even able to use them.{{Cite|Seggin, who is quite shock resistant for a Zora, hit one with a {{Color BotW|Blue|shock arrow}}. Sure enough, it slowed the water a bit.|Sidon|BotW}} In order to complete the [[Main Quest]] "[[Divine Beast Vah Ruta (Quest)|Divine Beast Vah Ruta]]", Link must use Shock Arrows when he faces the [[Divine Beast Vah Ruta|Divine Beast of the same name]] with [[Sidon]].{{Cite|We need you to use {{Color BotW|Blue|shock arrows}} to get those orbs working properly again!|Sidon|BotW}} [[Muzu]] received the task of locating the Shock Arrows, but he will leave before telling anyone where they are.{{Cite|I tased Muzu with finding the {{Color BotW|Blue|shock arrows}} we will need to appease {{Color BotW|Blue|Vah Ruta}}.|King Dorephan|BotW}} Hearing that [[Mipha]] was in love with Link, Muzu refuses to reveal their location unless he can prove it.{{Cite|If you are truly Lady Mipha's beloved, then prove it! Do so and I will tell you how to get those {{Color BotW|Blue|shock arrows}}, as well as anything else you wish to know.|Muzu|BotW}} Once he's convinced, he'll reveal that the arrows can be found in the territory of the Lynel on [[Ploymus Mountain]].{{Cite|That tall mountain over yonger... It is called {{Color BotW|Blue|Ploymus Mountain}}, and there you will also find {{Color BotW|Blue|Shatterback Point}}. A terrifying creature has made its home up there. This awful beast shoots volley after volley of {{Color BotW|Blue|shock arrows}}. Even a single one could be fatal to a Zora.|Muzu|BotW}} He estimates that Link will require at least twenty to face the beast.{{Cite|In order to appease the Divine Beast, I estimate that you will need...hmm... {{Color BotW|Red|at least 20}} {{Color BotW|Blue|shock arrows}}.|Muzu|BotW}} After they've been collected, Link can move on to the battle with Divine Beast Vah Ruta. ==Other Appearances== ==={{CoH|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|CoH}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Electric Arrow.jpg|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}A Shock Arrow being shot at Link File:BotW Link Fishing NM Promotional Screenshot.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}A promotional image from the {{NM|2022 Summer|Full|-}} featuring Link using a Shock Arrow to catch a few Fish File:CoH Lightning Arrow Sprite.png|{{Game Label|{{CoH|-}}}}A Lightning Arrow ==See Also== {{See Also| * Arrow * Electricity }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Arrows |items= BotW, CoH }}
